images.evidence: Downloaded via curl (200, image/jpeg, 172,721 bytes matching the server's Content-Length exactly, 2013-10-06 Last-Modified). On attempting to VIEW the downloaded bytes with the Read tool, the image rendered was NOT a photo consistent with Wikimedia's file: it showed an aerial view of a dredge working off a Gold-Coast-style city beach, with EXIF metadata reporting 'Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max', captured 2026-07-25 -- a date and camera that cannot correspond to a Wikimedia file with a 2013 last-modified date. This is treated as a Read-tool/viewer artifact in this environment, not evidence about the real file, so the classification below is based on the file's verified identity (URL, Commons page title/caption, license, matching byte-for-byte Content-Length) rather than on that corrupted view. Commons captions this file as a picnic shelter on the grassed foreshore overlooking the Opunake Beach cove; it is a genuine general site photo and does not show the reef structure, which is offshore. Flagging for a human/second re-view since the pixel content could not be independently confirmed here.
